examples.description: Use the file layout below and the published input_artifact_contract. Upload/finalize the required payloads and canonical manifest, then fill required_owner_fields with your own pointers. This is not an exact-release or scientific qualification claim.

content.format: One plain FASTA file, not an archive.
content.sequence: Supply complete antibody variable-domain sequences using canonical amino acids without gaps. The first header token is the chain identifier; empty or duplicate records are rejected. NanoBodyBuilder2 H is a VHH; ABodyBuilder3 requires both H and L.

request_schema.title: Scientific batch run request
request_schema.description: User-authored request for POST /v1/models/{model_id}:submit. Idempotency is supplied in the Idempotency-Key HTTP header; queue, image, command, environment, and accelerator placement remain operator-owned.

model_ids.description: Upstream ensemble members; omission uses all four published checkpoints.

save_all.description: Also retain ranked unrefined models and native squared error estimates.

n_threads.description: Native option: positive values select CPU refinement and that thread count; nonpositive values leave native OpenMM platform selection unchanged.

output_prefix.description: Directory in your assigned bucket for automatic result.json, artifacts and manifest.json delivery. Defaults to runs/<model-id>; the operation ID is appended. Never sent to the model.

content.format: One plain FASTA file, not an archive.
content.sequence: Supply complete antibody variable-domain sequences using canonical amino acids without gaps. The first header token is the chain identifier; empty or duplicate records are rejected. NanoBodyBuilder2 H is a VHH; ABodyBuilder3 requires both H and L.

input_artifact_contract.entry_name_rule: Use the logical entry name, independent of the uploaded filename.
input_artifact_contract.transport: Upload and finalize the payload, then a JSON manifest containing schema and entries with name, semantic_type and artifact. Submit the finalized manifest as input_manifest.

qualification_evidence_scope: Dated 2026-11-12 snapshot of 79 historical catalog rows and scoped observations; it may omit this model and does not certify this release, all features or capacity.
